The pay is INR 27,000 + HRA (30%, INR 8,100) for one year, subject to renewal. content_sections.heading: UoH Project Assistant at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

rows.details: Linking Mitochondrial Nucleoid Remodeling to Dysfunction of Macrophage Intrinsic Immune Responses to Intracellular Gram-positive and Gram-Negative Bacterial Infections

content_sections.heading: About the Project
content_sections.text: The post sits in the Department of Biochemistry, School of Life Sciences, University of Hyderabad. The notice is signed by Dr. Akash Gulyani, Professor, Department of Biochemistry. It says the selected candidate would have the opportunity to work in cutting edge, interdisciplinary life sciences, and points to the publications of the Gulyani lab, including Singh et al PNAS 2023 and Shettigar et al PNAS 2021.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only Indian nationals may apply. The notice prints the following for the single Project Assistant post. Strong expertise and knowledge of organic chemistry, physical organic chemistry, chemical biology, biophysical chemistry and fluorescence spectroscopy. OR experience, expertise and strong foundation in either: microbiology/cell biology/molecular biology techniques, biochemistry, immunohistochemistry, RNA preparation, RNA based manipulation, confocal imaging, image analysis including AIML, FACS, tissue culture. Work experience in a reputed research laboratory or strong, demonstrated expertise in relevant areas. The age limit is 35 Years. The notice prints no cut-off date for age and no age relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility for the post.

rows.essential_qualification: M.Sc/MTech. in natural sciences/Engineering OR Bachelors in Science/Engineering with three years' experience

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The remuneration is INR 27,000 + HRA. The HRA is 30%, printed as INR 8,100. The tenure of the post is one year, subject to renewal. The appointment is purely temporary, and appointed candidates have no right to claim any regular appointment in the University.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for UoH Project Assistant
content_sections.text: Prepare your CV and supporting documents, including self-attested copies of all certificates in support of the information furnished in the application. Email them to [email protected] . CC the email to [email protected] . Make sure the email reaches on or before 11 November 2026. The notice does not give an email subject line or a separate application form.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Review of applications will begin immediately. Eligible candidates will be called for an interview, and selected candidates will be informed by email. The notice does not give an interview date or venue.

content_sections.text: The appointments are purely temporary, with no right to claim any regular appointment in the University. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the written test / skill test or at the time of joining. Self-attested copies of all certificates in support of the information furnished in the application should be enclosed. Only Indian nationals may apply.

faq.question: Q1. How many Project Assistant vacancies are there at the University of Hyderabad?
faq.answer: There is 01 Project Assistant position in the ANRF-sponsored project of the Department of Biochemistry, School of Life Sciences.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the UoH Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: The CV and supporting documents must reach by email on or before 11 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the UoH Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: M.Sc/MTech. in natural sciences/Engineering OR Bachelors in Science/Engineering with three years' experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the UoH Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: The age limit is 35 Years, as printed in the notice.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the UoH Project Assistant?
faq.answer: The remuneration is INR 27,000 + HRA, with HRA at 30%, printed as INR 8,100.

faq.question: Q6. Is HRA paid on top of the INR 27,000?
faq.answer: Yes, the remuneration is printed as INR 27,000 + HRA, and HRA is given as 30%, INR 8,100.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for the UoH Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: Email your CV and supporting documents to [email protected] with a CC to [email protected], so that they reach on or before 11 November 2026.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: Applications are reviewed from the start, eligible candidates are called for an interview, and selected candidates are informed by email.

faq.question: Q9. Is the UoH Project Assistant post permanent?
faq.answer: No claim to regular appointment is allowed. The post is purely temporary, with a tenure of one year subject to renewal.

faq.question: Q10. Will TA/DA be paid to candidates?
faq.answer: No TA/DA will be paid for attending the written test / skill test or at the time of joining.
